headline: Weathered Expanse Rekindles as Callahans Passage Toll Mounts
war_summary: The three hours since our last edition have seen Weathered Expanse come roaring back: silent at the previous posting, the field has logged five flag events in the past two hours, and its daily losses now stand above thirteen thousand Colonial and seventeen thousand Warden. Mooring County has likewise wakened, its twelve works nearly all in Warden keeping even as Colonial losses there pass five thousand a day. Callahans Passage keeps its terrible arithmetic, hourly losses above a thousand men to each side, its ten works yet Warden-held. Fishermans Row remains the war's busiest post at fifty-two events, standing two Warden works against six Colonial and a ruin; Stlican Shelf's vacant ground has returned to Warden hands, six against three. Stonecradle and the Linn of Mercy have cooled; Farranac Coast's Bone Haft still turns; Godcrofts stirs faintly. Day 284; no victor declared.
